The proposal should **not** be implemented in configuration v1.

- V1 is a frozen published contract; changing its accepted fields, adapter names, or semantics would make existing reviewed YAML behave differently after an upgrade (`docs/decisions/0005-configuration-v1-compatibility.md:24`, `docs/decisions/0009-configuration-v2-and-universal-surfaces.md:9`).
- Continuity fields and universal surfaces already belong to v2: `continuity.checkpointDocument`, `continuity.generateSkills`, and the `agents`/`claude`/`gemini` adapters (`docs/decisions/0009-configuration-v2-and-universal-surfaces.md:20`).
- Existing v1 repositories remain supported without implicit rewriting. New initialization uses v2 (`docs/configuration.md:11`).
- The explicit, reviewable upgrade path is:

```bash
carrylog migrate --to 2 --universal --dry-run
carrylog migrate --to 2 --universal
carrylog validate
```

Migration preserves comments and line endings, maps `codex` to the shared `agents` surface, and refuses to reinterpret customized handoff prose without review (`docs/configuration.md:117`).

No repository changes were appropriate because this compatibility boundary and migration path are already implemented and documented.
